generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit target and canon reference

lighting_isotropy.metric: Repository gate formulas reproduced on the 2560 px Lanczos3 upscale with water cut out; 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean, plus circular gradient moments.
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: The candidate retains visible value separation between some exposed bench tops and faces. The strict one-flat-value rock rule is not established and the measured rock-only gate fails narrowly. Conifers also retain internal tonal modelling even though the aggregate key-light gate passes.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median classified crown-component width across 17 isolated conifers, scaled by 2560/1254.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: Manual visual estimate of non-water land area.
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Open moor, plateau benches, and the dry mill ledge count as buildable; exposed gorge and fall faces count as steep; dense stands, talus, and broken wooded ground make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: Opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha.
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour classification constrained to a loose visually traced water country, connected growth through painted wet pixels, fall and spray classification, raster closure across painted boulder interruptions, wet-edge expansion, component filtering, and enclosed-hole filling; not centreline geometry.

verification.full_repository_runner: The relocated scratch runner stalled before source derivation with zero CPU and no file progress and was terminated. No live public or art-source output was touched.
verification.replacement: The runner's published Sharp resize, mask-completion, 6 px and 48 px ring, key-light, gradient-ratio, and rock-light formulas were executed directly against this candidate at the final 2560 px scale.

open_risks: Rock-only lighting measures 0.152805 against the 0.15 limit, so this candidate is rejected by the stated lighting gate despite improving materially over the previous 0.189 result.

Visual inspection still finds tone-modelled rock faces and conifer interiors; the literal same-value-on-every-side rule is not satisfied by pixels merely because the aggregate key-light metric passes.
The source is the only permitted ImageGen result for this task. A valid square output does not authorize a quality retry, so no second generation call was made.
Buildable and steep fractions are manual visual estimates rather than surveyed slope classifications.
Seam brightness, exact geology naturalism, mill-ledge usefulness, and terrain quality remain director and owner visual judgments; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
